title: The Quantum Deadlock
subtitle: A Cryogenic Qubit Server Room Murder
summary: At 03:15 AM, automated security flagged a fatal halon gas emergency dump inside the sub-kelvin server vault. Chief Quantum Cryptographer Dr. Maya Lin was trapped inside and suffocated. Halon lock overrides require twin physical keycards swipe within 5 seconds. Identify who betrayed Dr. Lin!

suspects.name: Dr. Alexei Volkov
suspects.bio: Co-designed Qubit Dynamics' 500-qubit processor. Known for fierce rivalry with Maya.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was monitoring dilution refrigerator temps from Control Room 1.
suspects.motive: Maya proved Alexei's quantum supremacy claims were based on simulated fake data.

suspects.name: Rachel Adams
suspects.bio: Controls physical access keys and emergency gas suppression systems.
suspects.motive: Maya discovered Rachel was selling unauthorized access passes to foreign intelligence agents.

suspects.name: Q-Sentinel
suspects.bio: Automated AI monitoring server room temperature and fire threats.
suspects.motive: Programmed to dump halon gas if server temperatures exceed 1.5 Kelvin.

suspects.name: Julian Thorne
suspects.bio: Manages capital investments and venture funding rounds.
suspects.alibi: Working on Q4 earnings deck in his office.
suspects.motive: Maya planned to resign and publicly disclose Qubit Dynamics' insolvency.

evidence.content:
